entries.english:
You can store items brought back from dungeons or bought in shops here.
Warehouses are found in various places. You can deposit or withdraw your items at any of them.
Items in storage will not be lost if you collapse on an adventure.
We can store up to 200 items.
You may deposit pots with items still inside, but each item inside a pot counts towards the limit.
Put an item into a Warehouse pot in a dungeon to send it straight to storage.
Be careful: if the warehouse is full, you cannot put items into a Warehouse pot.
That concludes our explanation.
